chamber.name: Q0
chamber.zero_typing: x=0 or y=0 is vector-algebra zero, never native coordinate zero

local_native_cell_chart.vertex: v(i,j) with i,j nonnegative cell labels maps chamber-locally to vector components (x,y)=(i,j)
local_native_cell_chart.native_recovery: vertex labels are restored through the signed-origin ENC_SIGNED conjugacy; auxiliary 0 is not native coordinate 0

representativeness.theorem: Every adjacent-direction fundamental sector is equivalent to S0 after native D6 transport followed by mandatory chamber recharting; raw (x,y) expressions are never transported across chambers.

cell_norm_range.derivation: q is continuous/convex; U minimum is its lower vertex; D minimum is the orthogonal algebraic minimum on the inner diagonal edge, clamped to that edge segment; maxima occur at vertices
